## Public Git history checklist

- [ ] The PR title describes the engineering outcome in English.
- [ ] Commit subjects use Conventional Commits and do not expose internal agent terminology.
- [ ] New CHANGELOG text is user-facing and contains no workflow/wave/mandate/reviewer protocol language.
- [ ] No release/tag/publication action is included unless explicitly authorized.
